event.name: Codemotion Milano 2026
notes: Categoria e tag sono classificazioni redazionali, non track ufficiali Codemotion.
Tutte le sintesi sono redatte in italiano; soltanto quella di Elena Guidi è basata su abstract nel materiale originale.
Il programma è una fotografia dell’HTML del 15 ottobre 2026 e può subire variazioni.
Quattro voci organizzative del Tech Lead Summit senza speaker non sono incluse nell’elenco dei talk.

speakers.name: Abiodun Olowode
speakers.biography: Abiodun is the CTO and Co-Founder at Metrifox, where she leads the engineering team building impactful software. She specialises in streamlining workflows, reducing technical debt, and building reusable abstractions that unlock developer productivity through automation and strong defaults. She’s passionate about growing engineers and building cultures where excellence is the norm — and she writes and speaks regularly about leadership, engineering, and the uncomfortable parts of both.

speakers.name: Alessandro Festa
speakers.biography: Highly energetic, charismatic leader with Technical proficiency as well as a Business attitude. Product Manager, Coder, Passionate.

speakers.name: Alessandro Miliucci
speakers.biography: I am Alessandro Miliucci, a developer, author and speaker. Although I have many interests, software development is what I devote most of my time to and what I am best known for. I have also written a few books on software development. My interests range over all aspects of software: from user interfaces to databases, including network protocols. I am a co-organizer of RomaJS meetup and the leader of MongoDB User Group in Rome. During my career I have spent a lot of time working on start-ups such as Hype, the first Italian neo-bank, and Vidra, an e-commerce SaaS that I co-Founded. Nowadays I work as a Solution Architect for Fabrick S.p.a. one of the leading Italian Fintech companies.

speakers.name: Alessandro Riboni
speakers.biography: Alessandro Riboni is a Staff Engineer at Generali, specializing in AI engineering and GenAI platforms. Supports internal teams and builds horizontal tooling that standardizes and simplifies GenAI development: from a framework for prompt management, automated evaluation and CI/CD-based release of prompts, to Flowmetrics, a semantic layer that gives AI agents governed access to business metrics. Before that, five years in consulting for insurance and banking: first as a data engineer on real-time pipelines, then as an ML engineer building LLM-based claims assistants, RAG systems for policy risk assessment and document-parsing tools on AWS. Holds an MSc in Data Science from the University of Milano-Bicocca.

speakers.name: Alessio Acella
speakers.role: CTO, Founder, Software engineer at Omnes
speakers.biography: Alessio is CTO and Software Engineer at Omnes. Over the years, he has specialized in building tailored digital platforms, evolving from early work in C, C++, JAVA, PHP and Laravel to large-scale projects powered by modern stacks such as Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, React and Node.js. His technical journey has been shaped by constant curiosity for scalable architectures and performance-driven design. Alessio has worked extensively with cloud infrastructures on AWS, relational as well as NoSQL databases, real-time messaging, and modern headless frameworks. Today he leads teams building B2B and B2C platforms that combine strong engineering foundations with a focus on user experience and accessibility, while exploring how AI and automation are reshaping development practices.

speakers.name: Alexio Cassani
speakers.biography: Alexio Cassani is an Italian entrepreneur and thought leader in generative AI, AI agents, and corporate digital transformation. He is co-founder of FairMind, a startup that is building AI agent solutions that boost software development team productivity. A Computer Engineering graduate from Politecnico di Milano (2003), he was CTO at Cortilia and Webscience (now part of the Adesso group), founded the retail and e-commerce startup Stentle (acquired in 2019), and worked as a researcher with the Intranet and Cloud Observatories at Politecnico di Milano. He is adjunct professor at Politecnico di Milano School of Management, teaching Generative AI and advising companies on AI adoption and transformation. A frequent speaker at Italian and international conferences on generative AI, AI agents, software factory innovation, and responsible technology adoption, he is the author of "Code Revealed", a guide to how roles, organization, and tools in software development are evolving in the AI era.

speakers.name: Alfonso Fuggetta
speakers.biography: Alfonso Fuggetta is a Full Professor of Computer Science at Politecnico di Milano, where his work spans software engineering and digital transformation in their technical and managerial dimensions. He is the former CEO and Scientific Director of Cefriel and former Chief Digital Transformation Officer of Ferrari, and has been a Visiting Professor at NTNU, CU Boulder, and UC Irvine. For over thirty years, he has worked at the crossroads of software engineering research, industry, and innovation, advising companies and public institutions on digital transformation and the impact of AI. He is ranked among the top 2% of researchers worldwide (Elsevier/Stanford) and writes about technology and society on his Substack, "A bassa voce".

speakers.name: Alfonso Graziano
speakers.biography: Alfonso Graziano is a AI Tech Lead with a strong background in software engineering, specializing in JavaScript, AI and distributed systems. Currently at Nearform, Alfonso leads engineering teams to deliver impactful projects. Passionate about knowledge sharing, he loves to solve problems and contributes to tech communities.

speakers.name: Alfredo Morresi
speakers.biography: I help people to get things done, at the intersection of technology, community, leadership and fun. Community builder and developer by passion, Developer Relation @ Google by profession , I love being a dad, free-software, running on the beach, snowboarding. I relentlessly train myself in preparing (and eating) Tiramisù. I’m definitely yellow.

speakers.name: Alice Viola Setti
speakers.role: Senior Staff Engineer @ Smartness, author of Queen MQ
speakers.biography: Alice Viola Setti is a proud neurodivergent transgender woman, software engineer, architect, and sysadmin with a master's degree in Mechatronic Engineering and a product-builder mindset. Her background spans the entire technical spectrum, from provisioning bare-metal datacenters to architecting complex distributed systems and leading engineering teams. She is highly autonomous and drives end-to-end product delivery. She works mainly with Kubernetes, Kafka, Postgres, C++, Node, and Vue, and has shipped with Python, Ruby, Objective-C++, Swift, Rust, OpenCV, Proxmox, VMware, Nginx, HAProxy, Scylla, Redis, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Solr, Neo4j, Cassandra, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, NATS, and MQTT. She has installed and managed clusters in on-premise datacenters using bare-metal servers, hypervisors, and Kubernetes; configured network switches and firewalls; developed microservice architectures; built drone control systems; and conducted research in computer vision.

speakers.name: Andrea Ferlito
speakers.biography: ICT professional with over 20 years experience in software design and development and project management. His insane passion for videogames brought him to be well known through the italian and international game developer communities. He is also leader of Roma Game Dev community, organizing dedicated meetups and the famous Global Game Jam. He is CTO and Game Developer Content manager of Codemotion

speakers.name: Andrea Raponi
speakers.biography: Andrea Raponi è Technical Manager in Engineering, dove si occupa di architetture software, tecnologie Cloud Native e Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa. Ha trascorso buona parte della sua carriera a metà strada tra infrastruttura e sviluppo software, con una particolare curiosità per tutto ciò che succede “sotto il cofano”. È appassionato di open source, developer experience e di tecnologie costruite senza legarsi troppo a strumenti o vendor specifici. Quando non disegna architetture o scrive codice, probabilmente sta leggendo Thoreau, andando in bici o trasformando qualche nuova ossessione tecnologica in un side project.

speakers.name: Andrei Chiș
speakers.biography: Andrei Chiș is a tool crafter at feenk (feenk.com), where he builds tools and techniques to improve software development both with and without AI. He is also a co-author of the Glamorous Toolkit (gtoolkit.org) platform.

speakers.name: Andrey Breslav
speakers.biography: Andrey created the Kotlin programming language and led its development at JetBrains from 0 to millions of users. He’s the founder of CodeSpeak, a spec-based AI coding solution.

speakers.name: Aniello Bossa
speakers.biography: Aniello Bossa è Senior Data Engineer in Generali Italia, dove progetta e gestisce microservizi e pipeline dati su Google Cloud per i processi di gestione sinistri e antifrode. Lavora ogni giorno con Python, FastAPI, Kubernetes e Airflow, e si occupa di portare in produzione sistemi affidabili e osservabili su larga scala. Crede nella semplicità, nell'automazione e nel codice che si spiega da solo.

speakers.name: Aurélie Vache
speakers.role: Developer Advocate at OVHcloud, Docker Captain, CNCF Ambassador & GDE
speakers.biography: Aurélie Vache is a Developer Advocate at OVHcloud in Toulouse, France. She is a Docker Captain, CNCF ambassador, Google Cloud Developer Expert & Women techmarkers Ambassador. She has been working as a Developer and Ops for over 20 years. Cloud enthusiast and advocates DevOps/Cloud/Golang best practices. Technical writer (dev.to/aurelievache), a book author & reviewer, a sketchnoter and a speaker at international conferences. Conferences and meetups organizer since 2016. Creator and maintainer of https://developers.events/ , a collaborative, open-source platform that aggregates & list developer/tech-focused conferences/events and call-for-papers (CFP) opportunities worldwide, helping speakers, organizers, sponsors and attendees. She created a new visual way for people to learn and understand Cloud technologies: "Understanding Kubernetes/Istio/Docker in a visual way" in sketchnotes, books and videos. Blog: https://dev.to/aurelievache/ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/AurelieVache

speakers.name: Christian Schabetsberger
speakers.biography: Christian Schabetsberger, the world's okayest developer, is a Freelance Software Engineer & Architect from Linz, Austria with over a decade of experience. Having spend half of his life in the .NET ecosystem (amongst others), he likes to stay on the bleeding edge of technology to become the (tech-savvy) ninja he pretends to be since he is six. He is also an active community member, organising the .NET Meetup in Linz and supporting other local user groups. Furthermore he is a member of the .NET Foundation.

speakers.name: Costantino Cavallo
speakers.biography: Costantino Cavallo is the Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer at altermAInd and an international speaker with a strong passion for technology and continuous learning. He focuses on Automation and Artificial Intelligence, helping organizations maximize team efficiency through innovative methodologies and practical adoption of emerging technologies. Deeply committed to exploring new approaches, Costantino blends strategic vision with hands-on experimentation.

speakers.name: Daniel Zotti
speakers.role: Tech Lead & Team Lead @ Bitrock, Podcaster @ Shiftati di Testa
speakers.biography: Daniel è un software engineer da quasi 20 anni, specializzato nel frontend dal lontano 2013. Si definisce un Creative Web Developer perché ama portare una visione non banale nei progetti in cui è coinvolto. Nella sua carriera ha visto di tutto: da un’azienda di 5 persone al reparto IT di un ospedale, fino a una multinazionale da 20 mila dipendenti, senza farsi mancare il “classico” anno da freelance. Dal 2021 lavora nell'area front-end di Bitrock, una società di consulenza di Milano. Fuori dall'ufficio calca i palchi come improvvisatore teatrale, e si spaccia per stand-up comedian con i Gin Comici. Insieme a Stefano conduce Shiftati di Testa: Il podcast più atteso del web (anche se il web ancora non lo sa!)

speakers.name: Daniele Zonca
speakers.biography: Daniele Zonca is a Distinguised Engineer working for Red Hat. He contributes to many open source projects like TrustyAI, KServe, vLLM and llm-d. He is the Chief Architect for Red Hat Openshift AI product and before this he led Big Data development team of one of the largest Italian bank.

speakers.name: Danilo Deponti
speakers.biography: Danilo Deponti is a Senior Software Engineer, currently working in Doctolib, where he helps build the internal AI-augmented developer tools. His work focuses on autonomous coding agents, AI orchestration, and developer productivity, turning experimental LLM tooling into something teams can trust in production. He's passionate about pushing the boundaries of what AI can do inside a real engineering organisation: from agent fleets and persistent memory to observability, cost control, and keeping humans meaningfully in the loop.

speakers.name: David McCarter
speakers.role: Microsoft MVP (Developer Technologies), Software Architect, Speaker, Trainer, Inventor, and Mentor.
speakers.biography: **As David gradually winds down his career and looks toward retirement, now is the time to benefit from his experience, insight, and availability.** David McCarter is an exceptionally seasoned software engineer, a celebrated author, and a captivating speaker with a remarkable track record spanning over two decades within the industry. Holding the distinguished title of Microsoft MVP (Most Valuable Professional), David also serves as a solutions architect, Code Quality Zar, consultant, proficient code reviewer, and the esteemed editor-in-chief of dotNetTips.com. He has left an indelible mark on user groups, educational institutions, and prominent conferences worldwide, such as BuildStuff, Øredev, NDC, Copenhagen Developers Festival, Code Camp, SQL Saturday, DevConnections, and VSLive, among others. His instructional legacy even includes a tenure at the University of California, San Diego.

speakers.name: Davide Caldarulo
speakers.biography: Davide Caldarulo is a Senior Software Developer at Objectway's Bari office, where he designs and develops Java backend solutions for the financial sector. Passionate about technology and problem-solving, he enjoys turning complex challenges into simple, efficient solutions, always striving to deliver high-quality software that creates real value.

speakers.name: Davide Pensato
speakers.biography: In 1999 Davide Pensato starts his career as in-house Audio DirectorSound Designer at Ubisoft Studios Milano. In a couple of years he is responsible of audio team. Both a creative and technical figure, he can create audio for a game as well as integrating it using software and hardware tools. In January 2007 creates his own company (dpstudios) offering consulting and services for game audio. He develops web and multimedia projects too, as a new activity branch.

speakers.name: Dennis Nerush
speakers.biography: Dennis Nerush is the Director of AI at Elementor, where he leads the company's AI strategy and guides teams through the integration of GenAI technologies that enhance productivity while preserving human creativity and accountability. With over 15 years of experience as a developer, manager, director, and adviser across multiple tech companies and startups, Dennis has dedicated his career to building people-first cultures rooted in continuous learning, curiosity, and growth. He believes that when individuals thrive, teams and businesses flourish, a philosophy that has guided him in founding dozens of teams and mentoring over 100 managers. Dennis is a seasoned public speaker and writer who shares his insights on AI integration, leadership, and team performance at international conferences. He's passionate about helping leaders develop the skills and confidence to excel in a world where human leadership and AI collaboration go hand in hand.

speakers.name: Diana Bernabei
speakers.role: CEO, Co-Founder & Senior Accessibility Engineer @ AriaLab
speakers.biography: Sono una Frontend Developer freelance specializzata in consulenza sull'accessibilità, design UI/UX e sviluppo web. Il mio obiettivo è garantire che ogni sito web sia accessibile a tutti, indipendentemente dalle capacità fisiche o cognitive. Da oltre 5 anni, mi dedico con passione e professionalità a questo obiettivo, lavorando con semplicità e attenzione al dettaglio. Per me, l'accessibilità web va oltre la tecnologia: rappresenta una questione di diritti, uguaglianza e libertà.

speakers.name: Dotan Horovits
speakers.biography: Horovits lives at the intersection of technology, product and open source. With over 20 years in the tech industry as a software developer, a solutions architect and a product manager, he brings a wealth of knowledge in cloud-native architectures, big data solutions, DevOps practices and more. Horovits is an international speaker, an Ambassador of the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, and host of the popular OpenObservability Talks podcast. On the OpenSearch front, Horovits is an OpenSearch Ambassador under the Linux Foundation, he serves as a lead for the Observability technical advisory group, and is on the project’s outreach committee. Horovits works as a senior open source advocate at Amazon Web Services, with special focus on the OpenSearch project, open observability, and open source practices.

speakers.name: Edoardo Dusi
speakers.biography: Edoardo is a Developer Relations Engineer. He has a strong software developer and team leader background, working on various projects and platforms. He is passionate about creating and sharing content that educates and inspires other developers, such as tech talks, videos, podcasts, conferences, and more. He enjoys connecting with the developer community and promoting the benefits of open source software.

speakers.name: Egon Ferri
speakers.biography: Putting AI into production is not just about connecting a model to a chat interface. In Gamindo AI, we built a workflow that turns vague requirements, source materials and live game state into structured game-based learning content: it refines the initial intent, generates a validated learning experience, supports controlled edits through structured patches, and produces contextual commentary and audio aligned with gameplay. This talk walks through the architecture behind it: typed contracts with PydanticAI, FastAPI endpoints, fallback strategies across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, streaming events, output validation, eval datasets, custom evaluators, observability with Logfire, and practical error handling. Attendees will leave with patterns and tradeoffs for designing AI workflows that are robust, observable, measurable and flexible enough to evolve without rewriting everything.

speakers.name: Elena Guidi
speakers.biography: Senior Software Developer at Thoughtworks A developer with 8 years of experience across Italy and abroad, Elena bridges the gap between clean code and clear communication. At Thoughtworks, she balances technical delivery with a mission to debug the "Human Stack." Through the lens of Crucial Conversations and Green Computing, she equips teams to handle high-stakes friction and build a more sustainable digital future. Code is logical; people are complex. She helps you master both.

speakers.name: Emanuele Fabbiani
speakers.role: Co-founder and head of AI at xtream (acquired by TeamSystem), Professor at Catholic University of Milan
speakers.biography: Emanuele is an entrepreneur, engineer, and researcher passionate about achieving impact with AI. After earning his PhD in machine learning and working as a guest researcher at EPFL in Lausanne, he is now co-founder and Head of AI at xtream, a company that applies AI to solve complex business challenges. xtream was acquired by TeamSystem in September 2025. Emanuele is also a professor of AI at the Catholic University of Milan and has been a guest lecturer at Italian, Swiss, and Polish universities. He has published 8 papers in international journals with 175+ citations and contributed to over 30 international conferences, including AMLD Lausanne, ODSC London, WeAreDevelopers Berlin, PyData Berlin, PyData Paris, PyCon Italy, the Swiss Python Summit, and Codemotion Milan and Rome.

speakers.name: Emmanuele Villa
speakers.biography: Emmanuele Villa is a Senior Technical Consultant at Fincons Group, leading mobile and web development with technologies like Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose, and SwiftUI. He also teaches at the Università della Terza Età in Carate Brianza and is pursuing a degree in Middle Age History, bridging his passion for technology and the humanities. Outside of work, he enjoys exploring Quantum Computing, running Dungeons&Dragons, and reading One Piece.

speakers.name: Enzo Lombardi
speakers.role: Cleafy, 🌩️ Cloud Software Architect 🦀 Learning Rust 🕹️ Mame contributor 🔬 Arduino thinkerer: ESP32, nrf52 🔍 Former Google and Microsoft dev 🥞 Almost-full stack developer (can't align with CSS)
speakers.biography: Former software engineer, spent large part of my career in US working for Microsoft, Google and startups. In Microsoft I was part of the original .Net team and later worked on Windows Compatibility Toolkit and Windows Performance Analyzer. In Google I worked for Hangouts during its glory days, and moved to work on the Directory product part of Google Workplace offer. I moved back to Italy in Summer 2023 to pivot my career as Software Architect in order to bring my experience to use in a fast growing company working on a interesting product. I am learning by teaching Rust and successfully contributed to Mame bringing the sound effects to the Italian arcade game dribbling. Book author of: Tu lo conosci Claude vol. 1 and 2 OOP to Rust (English and Italian) Multiplatform UI in Rust

speakers.name: Erik Pronk
speakers.biography: Erik Pronk is a passionate software engineer that has been working in IT since 2001. During this period he has gained a lot of experience in a variety of technologies, roles, development environments and market segments. His main focus is on implementing enterprise solutions in an agile way. In his spare time, Erik loves to run and experiment with VR and domotics. Erik works at JDriven where he shares his passion and drive with other colleagues.

speakers.name: Ettore Di Giacinto
speakers.biography: I’m Ettore and I’m a long-time Open Source hacker and hacktivist. I’ve been involved in the Open Source community for more than 18 years. I’ve studied CS at University, and pursued my degree at full votes with a MS in Computer Science. I formerly was a Gentoo developer, I did lead Sabayon Linux and contributed to several FOSS projects among openSUSE, Cloud Foundry, openQA, llama.cpp. Previously I’ve worked at SUSE where I was leading the Elemental team. At Spectro Cloud I've created Kairos and donated it to CNCF, and collaborated with Intel on SENA ( Secure Edge-Native Architecture). I am a Golang and Kubernetes enthusiast with a strong Linux background skillset. I am the LocalAI creator and maintainer.

speakers.name: Francesco Facconi
speakers.role: Speaker on Digitalia - Senior Engineering Manager at Doctolib
speakers.biography: Engineer, manager, former startupper, broadcasting every Monday evening on Digitalia, one of the longest-lasting Podcast in Italy, speaking about technology and how this interacts with our lives. His last book is "Almanacco Digitaliano 2024" from Ledizioni Publishing. Musician and performer with more than 400 gigs.

speakers.name: Francesco Pirrone
speakers.biography: Graduated in Computer Science from the University of Turin, he is a full-stack developer at Finwave, where he is responsible for the design and development of distributed systems. Nerd at 99%, he is trying to stay in touch with the real world for the remaining 1% of his day. Since 2018, he is one of the Community Leader for GDG Cloud Turin.

speakers.name: Gabriele Negro
speakers.biography: Gabriele is a technology leader with extensive experience in building digital platforms and enterprise software solutions. He currently works on AI-driven products focused on transforming how people learn, work, and make decisions inside organizations. With a background in software architecture and large-scale systems, he has led projects in banking, fintech, and cloud-native environments, helping companies adopt modern architectures and artificial intelligence in real business scenarios. Today his main focus is on the impact of AI on society and the workplace, exploring how tools like generative AI and vibe coding are changing the way software is built and how companies operate.

speakers.name: Gabriele Santomaggio
speakers.biography: RabbitMQ team member, working with distributed systems, open source lover, Linux fan.

speakers.name: Gianni Forlastro
speakers.role: Google GDE Cloud, Cloud Architect, GDG Cloud Torino & Flutter Torino Community Lead
speakers.biography: Inizia la sua avventura con un Intel 80386 e si laurea in Informatica all'Università di Torino che completa con due master: Comunicazione Digitale/Web Marketing e Social Media Management, il secondo in Cloud Computing. Dopo esperienze come sviluppatore web e mobile, oggi è Cloud Architect, docente e assistente universitario, co-organizzatore di droidcon Italy, Swift Heroes e Flutter Heroes. Lato community nel 2018 fonda il GDG Cloud Torino, diventa Google Champion Innovator nel 2023 e Google GDE Cloud nel 2025. Su Instagram è noto come @mosquitoman81, tra i creator italiani più seguiti su giochi e fiere.

speakers.name: Giorgio Natili
speakers.role: Head of AI Engineering for Oracle Support
speakers.biography: Giorgio Natili is a technologist, ethicist, and builder working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, human dignity, and data sovereignty. As Senior Director and Head of AI Engineering for Oracle Cloud Support, he leads the design and deployment of AI systems that make enterprise support smarter, faster, and more trustworthy at scale. His expertise in Sovereign AI—the principle that individuals, organizations, and nations must retain control over their data, models, and AI-driven decisions—comes from years of hands-on work. At OPAQUE Systems, where he served as VP and Head of Engineering, he built confidential AI infrastructure that enabled insights from sensitive data without exposing it. This shaped his belief that ethical AI and sovereign AI are inseparable. With experience at Amazon, Mozilla, Capital One, OPAQUE Systems, and Oracle, he focuses on building AI that is powerful without being exploitative.

speakers.name: Giovanni Galloro
speakers.biography: Giovanni Galloro is a Customer Engineer at Google, where he has been working since 2017. Over the years, he has built deep expertise in developer productivity and software delivery tools and practices. Today, he partners with engineering organizations across Europe to help them unlock the full potential of AI, improving how teams build, ship, and iterate on software at scale.

speakers.name: Giulio D'Alessandro
speakers.role: AI Knowledge Architect at Poste Italiane
speakers.biography: Giulio D'Alessandro is a philosophy graduate who turned to software. He joined Poste Italiane five years ago and started out as a DevOps engineer. Then AI arrived and sent him back where he began. When machines can build anything, the rare skill is knowing what's worth building — and why. He now works in Poste Italiane's Digital Technology Office, between the rigour of formal models and the messiness of what people actually mean.

speakers.name: Giulio Sciarappa
speakers.role: Enterprise Architect, Head of Azure & AI
speakers.biography: Enterprise architect with multiple job experiences in different fields, from banking to aerospace, with a spice of DevOps and other less known methodologies

speakers.name: Graziano Casto
speakers.role: Developer Relations Engineer @ Akamas | Tech Lead @ CNCF TAG DevEx | Kubernetes v1.35 Comms Lead
speakers.biography: Graziano is a DevRel Engineer at Akamas, where he spends his days convincing computers to stop being lazy and start being efficient. A former distributed systems developer and product manager, he’s now on a mission to optimize the entire cloud-native universe, one Pod at a time. As a Tech Lead for the CNCF TAG DevEx and a member of the Kubernetes Release Team since v1.34, he balances deep infrastructure roots with a passion for developer happiness. Obsessed with AI, Platform Engineering, and saving the planet through better code, Graziano is basically trying to make the cloud faster, greener, and significantly less annoying for everyone. More on: https://castograziano.com/

speakers.name: Gregorio Palamà
speakers.role: GDE Cloud | Senior Enterprise Architect @ adesso.it | Community Manager @ GDG Pescara
speakers.biography: I have been working in the IT industry for over 15 years. I currently hold the role of Senior Enterprise Architect in adesso.it. I am a Google Developer Expert on GCP and a Google Cloud Innovator Champion on the topic of modern architecture. I manage GDG Pescara together with other developers, I love sharing my knowledge and trying to do it in a fun way.

speakers.name: Guglielmo Fancellu
speakers.role: AI Knowledge Architect at Poste Italiane
speakers.biography: Guglielmo studied philosophy, then became a software architect at Poste Italiane. Over time the focus shifted toward AI and language models, with a growing interest in computational linguistics. These days the work is ontology design: building semantic models that help machines understand what people actually mean. Turns out Plato comes in handy after all

speakers.name: Jigyasa Grover
speakers.role: AI/ML Lead Engineer • 12x AI + Open Source Award Winner • Google Advisory Board Member • 'Sculpting Data for ML' Book Author • Featured @ Business Insider, Google, UN, and more!
speakers.biography: Jigyasa Grover is a 12-time award-winning AI leader and author of Sculpting Data for ML, driving cutting-edge personalization at Uber after transforming ML systems at Twitter/X, Meta/Facebook, Faire, and Bordo AI. featured at Google I/O keynote and a Google Developer Advisory Board member, she operates at the intersection of large-scale AI, product innovation, and global influence, educating thousands as a LinkedIn Learning instructor while advising top Silicon Valley startups. Recognized by Forbes, Business Insider, World Economic Forum, and many others, she is shaping the future of AI through leadership, research, and impact at global scale.

speakers.name: katharine jarmul
speakers.role: Privacy and Security in AI Systems
speakers.biography: Katharine Jarmul focuses her work and research on privacy and security in data science, deep learning and AI. She is author of the well received O'Reilly book Practical Data Privacy (O'Reilly 2023) and has more than 10 years experience in machine learning/AI where she has helped build large scale AI systems with privacy and security built in. You can follow her work via her newsletter, Probably Private or on her website at https://kjamistan.com .

speakers.name: Laura Miranda
speakers.role: C-Level Consultant, Marketing Manager, Digital Enthusiast
speakers.biography: Ha sempre vissuto la passione per il marketing e la Comunicazione come uno strumento di Business Development. Avere un sogno, trasformarlo in obiettivi sfidanti, analizzare e pianificare le attività cercando sempre elementi di disruption e costruire un team unito. Il suo approccio al management l' ha portato a svolgere tante belle esperienze all'estero dove ha aperto la mente a stili di vita e modi di pensare differenti. Dopo una parentesi imprenditoriale, ha deciso di tornare in Italia mettendo la sua esperienza a supporto della Digital Trasformation delle PMI. Le piacciono le persone, ama ascoltare e leggere tanto. Se hai un sogno... make it happen!

speakers.name: Leonardo Cavagnis
speakers.biography: Since 2023, I have been working as a firmware engineer at Arduino, contributing to the development of innovative hardware and software solutions. I hold a Master's Degree in Computer Engineering from Politecnico di Milano, specializing in embedded systems. Before joining Arduino, I gained experience in various fields, including industrial, automotive, and green mobility. Passionate about technical writing and traveling, I am always seeking new experiences and knowledge.

speakers.name: Luca Bianchi
speakers.role: CTO | AWS Serverless Hero | Cursor Ambassador | Production AI/ML & Event-Driven Architecture at Scale
speakers.biography: Over the past decade, I've architected production AI/ML systems. AWS Hero and Cursor Ambassador focused on cost-optimized AI infrastructure and real-time data pipelines.
